svg.aria-label: A movable pulley: the wheel is attached directly to the load and moves with it. One end of the rope is anchored to a fixed point at the top; the rope runs down around the movable pulley and back up to where the effort pulls. Two rope segments support the load, giving a mechanical advantage of approximately 2.
